service.label: Service
legacy.队列已完成，等待执行系统操作: The queue is complete; waiting to run the system action

legacy.搜索插件名称、标签或游戏: Search plugin names, tags, or games

legacy.远程管理入口与本机 Agent 服务: Remote management entry points and the local Agent service
legacy.更新渠道、检查与应用操作: Update channel, checks, and apply actions
legacy.检查运行环境、恢复现场与插件状态: Check the runtime environment, recovery state, and plugin status
legacy.有需要重启服务的设置已保存。: Settings that require a service restart have been saved.
legacy.轻量模式请手动重启程序。: In lightweight mode, restart the program manually.
legacy.注册到当前用户启动项: Register in the current user's startup items
legacy.不启动网页服务，重启后生效: Do not start the web service; takes effect after restart
legacy.服务启动后自动打开控制台: Open the console automatically when the service starts
legacy.日志级别即时生效；Web 端口改动需重启服务。: Log level changes apply immediately; Web port changes require a service restart.
legacy.轻量模式未启动 Web 服务，重启请手动操作。: Lightweight mode did not start the Web service. Restart manually.

legacy.留空时保持当前令牌不变。: Leave blank to keep the current token.
legacy.重启后监听本机 MCP 端点: Listen on the local MCP endpoint after restart
legacy.端点：http://127.0.0.1:{port}/mcp；端口: Endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:{port}/mcp. Port and tool permission changes require a restart. If the port is occupied, MCP remains unavailable while the Control API continues running.
legacy.代理地址需要包含 http:// 或 https://。: The proxy address must include http:// or https://.
legacy.留空时保持已保存的代理密码不变。: Leave blank to keep the saved proxy password.
legacy.发送运行状态到 Webhook 服务: Send run status to the Webhook service
legacy.脚本完成通知附带所选截图；队列汇总通知不附图: Script completion notifications include selected screenshots; queue summaries do not include screenshots
legacy.留空时保持已保存的 Webhook 地址不变。: Leave blank to keep the saved Webhook URL.
legacy.留空时保持已保存的 Webhook 签名密钥不变。: Leave blank to keep the saved Webhook signing secret.
legacy.JSON 模板中的 {text}、{imageBase64}、{i: {text}, {imageBase64}, {imageDataUri}, {imageFileName}, and {imageContentType} in the JSON template are replaced with their corresponding values.
legacy.用于上传图片的自建应用凭据。: Credentials for the custom app used to upload images.
legacy.留空时保持已保存的 App Secret 不变。: Leave blank to keep the saved App Secret.
legacy.机器人需要已加入该频道。: The bot must already be a member of this channel.
legacy.留空时保持已保存的 Bot Token 不变。: Leave blank to keep the saved Bot Token.
legacy.服务启动约 5 秒后首次检查，此后每 12 小时自动检查: Check about 5 seconds after service startup, then every 12 hours
legacy.发现新版本后自动下载，并在宿主空闲且未来 5 分钟无调度时自动更新: Download new versions automatically, then update and restart when the host is idle and no run is scheduled within the next 5 minutes
legacy.留空时使用默认 GitHub 更新源。: Leave blank to use the default GitHub update source.
legacy.全部通过或按条件跳过: All passed or were skipped by condition
A new version was found. Downloading and verifying the package automatically...
legacy.更新已就绪，正在等待宿主空闲后自动应用。: The update is ready and waiting for the host to become idle before applying.
legacy.更新已就绪，应用前请确认没有正在运行的任务。: The update is ready. Confirm that no tasks are running before applying it.
legacy.更新已登记，将在下次启动时应用。: The update is queued and will be applied at the next startup.
Applying the update automatically; the service will restart soon...
legacy.检测到未完成的更新恢复现场，请重启服务完成恢复后再检查更新。: An incomplete update recovery state was found. Restart the service to finish recovery, then check again.
legacy.等待首次自动检查，服务启动约 5 秒后执行。: Waiting for the first automatic check, which runs about 5 seconds after service startup.
legacy.尚未检查更新。: Updates have not been checked yet.
legacy.当前已是最新版本。: You are running the latest version.
legacy.应用更新前请先备份 config、data、history、log: Back up runtime data such as config, data, history, logs, plugins, and .nxp before applying the update.
legacy.现在应用更新并重启服务: Apply the update and restart the service now
legacy.请确认已备份运行时数据。{action}{version}？更新备: Confirm that runtime data has been backed up. {action}{version}? The update backup contains only program files and wwwroot.
legacy.可先等待任务结束，或选择「下次启动更新」: Wait for the task to finish, or choose “Update on next startup”
legacy.已登记：下次启动服务时自动应用: Queued: the update will be applied at the next service startup
The update has started. The service will restart and recover automatically; the page connection will be interrupted briefly...
legacy.服务重启超时，请手动刷新页面: Service restart timed out. Refresh the page manually.
legacy.当前没有可复制的令牌: There is no token to copy
legacy.复制访问令牌失败，请手动复制: Could not copy the access token. Copy it manually.
Other devices should use the LAN address. localhost and 0.0.0.0 point only to this machine; the first visit requires an access token.
legacy.统一管理用户头像、脚本绑定、运行优先级和通知设置。: Manage user avatars, script bindings, run priority, and notification settings.
legacy.点击右上角「添加用户」创建用户后，再为它绑定一个或多个脚本实例。: Click “Add user” in the upper-right corner, then bind one or more script instances.
legacy.用户名最多 {bytes} 字节: Usernames may contain at most {bytes} bytes
legacy.用户名已存在，请使用其他名称: That username already exists. Choose another name.
legacy.删除「{name}」会解除全部脚本绑定并清理该用户的配置数据。请输: Deleting “{name}” removes all script bindings and clears this user's configuration. Enter the full username to confirm.
legacy.请输入完整用户名以确认删除: Enter the full username to confirm deletion
legacy.启动主程序打开该脚本实例的用户配置: Start the main program and open this script instance's user configuration
legacy.绑定启用状态、运行天数和每日成功次数。: Binding status, run days, and daily success count.
legacy.运行天数为 0 时不会参与运行: A run-days value of 0 excludes it from runs
legacy.填写 -1 永久运行；填写 0 则不运行该脚本实例；填写 0 以上: Enter -1 to run indefinitely, 0 to disable this script instance, or a positive number to run it while decrementing daily.
legacy.-1 表示永久运行；0 表示停止该脚本实例；正数表示剩余运行天数，: -1 means indefinitely; 0 stops this script instance; positive values are remaining run days and decrease daily.
legacy.-1 表示不限制；正整数达到上限后跳过，0 不是有效值。: -1 means unlimited; a positive value skips runs after the limit is reached; 0 is invalid.
legacy.当天成功次数达到上限后，后续手动运行和自动运行将记录为已跳过；失败: After the daily success limit is reached, later manual and automatic runs are recorded as skipped; failures, cancellations, and skips do not count.
legacy.用户绑定允许时发送运行结果通知。: Send run-result notifications when allowed by the user binding.
legacy.按用户绑定设置发送运行状态通知: Send run status notifications using the user binding settings
legacy.留空继承全局收件人: Leave blank to inherit global recipients
legacy.仅 SMTP 使用；留空时继承全局收件人，Webhook 不受影响: Used only by SMTP; leave blank to inherit global recipients. Webhook is unaffected.
legacy.每个绑定独立保存运行、通知和高级选项设置。: Each binding stores its run, notification, and advanced settings independently.
legacy.没有可添加的脚本实例: No script instances can be added
legacy.所有脚本实例都已绑定。: All script instances are already bound.
legacy.从上方「添加脚本」选择脚本实例后添加绑定。: Choose script instances from “Add script” above to add bindings.
legacy.开启后覆盖每个脚本绑定的通用设置: When enabled, override the general settings of every script binding
legacy.关闭后所有绑定均不参与运行: When disabled, no binding participates in runs
legacy.开启后覆盖每个脚本绑定的通知设置: When enabled, override the notification settings of every script binding
legacy.统一控制所有脚本绑定的通知开关与 SMTP 收件人。: Control notification switches and SMTP recipients for all script bindings.
legacy.开启后覆盖每个脚本绑定的高级设置: When enabled, override the advanced settings of every script binding
legacy.统一控制所有脚本绑定的任务前后脚本。: Control before- and after-task scripts for all script bindings.
legacy.由当前已启用的插件提供的用户级设置。: User-level settings provided by currently enabled plugins.
legacy.配置已保存，但专项插件配置校验执行失败。: Configuration saved, but specialized plugin validation failed.

legacy.创建一个脚本实例后，它会出现在这里并可加入调度队列。: Create a script instance and it will appear here to be added to a queue.
legacy.手动配置主程序、自启动参数、配置与日志路径: Configure the main program, startup arguments, configuration, and log paths manually
legacy.由专用插件自动适配配置: Configuration is adapted automatically by the specialized plugin
legacy.无法从该根目录推导专项配置：: Could not derive specialized configuration from this root directory:

legacy.请先填写脚本根目录: Enter the script root directory first
legacy.选择主程序后仍可手动修改路径。: You can still edit the path after choosing the main program.
Optional; for example, -x --mode=1. If the value starts with a path (such as .\app.exe?-args), the content after the question mark is used as arguments.
legacy.配置路径相对于脚本根目录，可选择配置文件或配置文件夹。: The configuration path is relative to the script root and may point to a file or folder.
legacy.日志路径（支持日期占位符与通配符）: Log path (date placeholders and wildcards supported)
legacy.支持日期占位符与通配符；例如 D:\\Scripts\\logs\: Date placeholders and wildcards are supported; for example, D:\Scripts\logs\{YYYY-MM-DD}.log or D:\Scripts\logs\*.log.
legacy.路径/ADB 用于失败清理与重试恢复: Path/ADB is used for failure cleanup and retry recovery
legacy.任务开始前主动启动游戏: Launch the game before the task starts
legacy.任务结束或失败时清理游戏进程: Clean up game processes when the task ends or fails
legacy.运行结束时同步用户配置: Sync user configuration when the run ends

legacy.日志无更新达到此分钟数后判定当前尝试停滞；填 -1 表示长时脚本。: The attempt is considered stalled after this many minutes without new log output; enter -1 for a long-running script.
legacy.限制整次任务总运行时间；长时脚本可填 -1（永不超时），普通脚本需: Limit the total task time. Long-running scripts may use -1 (never time out); standard scripts need a valid number. The total includes retries and before/after-task scripts.
legacy.逗号表示 AND，多行表示 OR: Commas mean AND; separate lines mean OR
legacy.命中即判定失败: A match marks the attempt as failed
legacy.选择判断脚本执行语言；JavaScript 使用内置引擎，Pyth: Choose the judge script language. JavaScript uses the built-in engine; Python uses the system interpreter.
legacy.使用判断脚本，脚本优先: Use judge script; script takes priority
legacy.脚本名称最多 {bytes} 字节: Script names may contain at most {bytes} bytes
legacy.脚本名称已存在，请使用其他名称: That script name already exists. Choose another name.
legacy.最大尝试次数须在 {min}-{max} 之间: Maximum attempts must be between {min} and {max}
legacy.日志无更新超时须在 {min}-{max} 分钟之间: Log inactivity timeout must be between {min} and {max} minutes
legacy.运行总时间超时须在 {min}-{max} 分钟之间: Total run timeout must be between {min} and {max} minutes
legacy.日志无更新上限未填 -1 时，运行总时间上限不能填 -1: The total run time cannot be -1 unless the log inactivity limit is also -1
legacy.请填写判断脚本代码，或关闭「使用脚本」: Enter judge script code or turn off “Use judge script”
Invalid emulator ADB address (expected host:port, such as 127.0.0.1:16384)

legacy.am start 参数，如 -n 包名/.MainActivity: am start arguments, such as -n package/.MainActivity
legacy.使用 PC 客户端时，禁用该选项。: This option is disabled when using a PC client.
legacy.模拟器模式下，该内容会作为 adb shell am start: In emulator mode, this value is passed as adb shell am start arguments.
legacy.启动游戏后等待指定秒数，再运行脚本。: Wait the specified number of seconds after launching the game, then run the script.
legacy.客户端由脚本自身启动；启动参数与等待秒数不可配置，游戏路径用于失败: The client is launched by the script. Startup arguments and wait time cannot be configured; the game path is used to force-close the game after a failure.
legacy.游戏路径用于失败清理与重试恢复。: The game path is used for failure cleanup and retry recovery.
legacy.运行完成时保存的展示快照: Display snapshot saved when the run completes
legacy.完整日志不存在或已被清理: The full log does not exist or has been cleaned up
legacy.点击日期选择范围，今天及之后的日期不可选: Click a date to choose a range; today and later cannot be selected
legacy.请选择开始日期和结束日期: Choose a start date and an end date
legacy.开始日期不能晚于结束日期: The start date cannot be later than the end date
legacy.日志较长，默认只加载尾部: This log is long; only the tail is loaded by default
legacy.保存脚本实例响应中的专项校验结果: Specialized validation results in the saved script instance response
legacy.下次启动服务时应用更新: Apply the update when the service starts next time

legacy.备注最多 {bytes} 字节: Notes may contain at most {bytes} bytes

legacy.点击日期下的用户查看当天运行记录。: Click a user under a date to view that day’s run records.

legacy.绑定脚本实例顺序无效: The script binding order is invalid

legacy.该时间段暂无记录: No records in this time range

legacy.，全部通过或按条件跳过: , all passed or were skipped by condition

legacy.队列名称已存在，请使用其他名称: That queue name already exists. Choose another name.
legacy.定时列表已达上限（{count}/{maximum}）: The schedule list has reached its limit ({count}/{maximum})
legacy.任务列表的启用用户总数已达上限（{count}/{maximum}: The total enabled users in the task list has reached its limit ({count}/{maximum})
